title: bonsai.log/1
description: The log record (contract §8.1): one JSON line, at most 2,048 bytes, per thing an agent did or Bonsai recorded (a tool call, a guard decision, a ladder result, an ask, an outside event, a cleaned file, a message between agents, an agent started, an agent's token counts). Records are appended whole to the main checkout's .bonsai/local/log/ (s-<session>.ndjson per session, w-<YYYY-MM-DD>.ndjson outside one), never committed, redacted as written. Written by Bonsai's recorder (the hooks) and its own commands; read by bonsai logs and the studio's forwarder (Bonsai has no screens of its own). A writer writes every field below, in this order, null where it does not apply (contract §2.2, §2.5); a reader treats a missing field as null, keeps an unknown one, and refuses a duplicate key. The last two fields, bonsai_path and bonsai_sha256, name the bonsai binary that wrote a session's records (spec §16 row 27); they are the names the guard has written since part 5, added to the schema in set 6. Set 8 adds parent and usage after them, the last two: the agent that started a spawn record's agent, and a usage record's token counts.

format.description: The version, always the first field (contract §2.2). Today's spool wrote v: 1.

id.description: A UUID for the record; a replayed line with the same id is a duplicate.

at.description: When it happened: ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds.

workspace.description: The workspace id from bonsai.yaml (contract §3): ws- and 26 lowercase base32 characters. The bridge maps it to the studio's project id. Today's spool field: project.

session.description: The agent's session id, or null outside a session (an outside event, a command run by hand).

agent.description: The agent program: claude-code today (contract §2.7); null for a record no agent made.

agent_event.description: The agent's own event name (contract §8.3), such as Claude Code's PostToolUse; null for Bonsai's own records. Today's spool field: event.

event.description: Bonsai's event name (contract §8.2). An open list: its known words, one line each on what they mean, live in Bonsai's one table of log events, which bonsai check --schema bonsai.log prints (and the reference page of lists, docs/reference/lists.md, lists); this schema does not copy them, and a reader shows a word it does not know as other.

subagent_id.description: Claude Code only: the subagent that acted, or null. Today's spool field: agent_id. On a spawn record, the agent started; on a usage record, the agent whose transcript was read (null for a session's own).

subagent_type.description: Claude Code only: the subagent's type, or null. Today's spool field: agent_type. On a spawn record, the type the agent was started as.

tool_use_id.description: Claude Code only: the tool call's id, pairing its start and end records; null when no tool call. On a spawn record, the Agent call that started the agent, the same as that call's guard record.

input_hash.description: Pairs a call's start and end records without keeping its input: as today, the first 16 hex characters of an HMAC-SHA-256 keyed by the machine's salt. null when no tool call.

checkout.description: The working tree's folder name, never its path (contract §2.6). Today's spool field: worktree.

branch.description: The working tree's branch, or null.

task.description: The task the session's environment names (BONSAI_TASK), raw, as given and redacted like every free-text field; null when unset. For a ladder record, the result's task. The recorder decides nothing from it. Today's spool field: task_env. For message, the message's task.

role.description: The role the session's environment names (BONSAI_ROLE), raw, as given and redacted like every free-text field; null when unset. Today's spool field: role_env.

category.description: The tool's category (contract §8.2). An open list: its known words live in Bonsai's one table of log categories, which bonsai check --schema bonsai.log prints (and the reference page of lists lists); this schema does not copy them. A pack's own categories are written <namespace>.<Name>, and a reader shows a word it does not know as other. null when no tool.

target.description: What the tool acted on, redacted, at most 200 characters; a path outside the checkout is null, never written. For session_start and subagent_start the active task the recorder found (contract §13), or null; for clean the project-relative path deleted; for ask the ask's key; for ladder the result's project-relative path. For message, the message's id (bonsai.message/1).

ok.description: Whether the call succeeded (true), failed (false), or null when that does not apply; for a ladder record, the result's green.

kind.description: What kind of the event it is, or null: a prompt's user or task-notification; a failure's interrupt or error; a notice's type (Claude Code's notification type); for an ask record, its op (file, resolve or answer); for a ladder record, the result's mode (local or ci). For a usage record, null when the transcript was read and unknown when it could not be (its reason in reason).

text.description: Short text, redacted, at most 300 characters: a notice's message, or an ask record's question, or for a ladder record sha256: and the result file's SHA-256 in hex; never the words of a prompt (a prompt record's text is null). null where it does not apply. For message, its kind, its recipient's address and, for a report, its status.
examples: Claude is waiting for your input

source.description: As today: where a session started from (Claude Code's SessionStart source), or null.

model.description: As today: the session's model, as the agent names it, or null. For a usage record, the model whose token counts it holds, as the transcript names it.

reason.description: As today: why a session ended (Claude Code's SessionEnd reason); for clean, the rule that cleaned the file (contract §8.2); or null. For a usage record whose transcript could not be read (kind unknown), why.

decision.description: For a guard record: allow or deny; null otherwise.

rule.description: For a guard record: the name of the rule that decided; null otherwise.

labels.description: For an event record only: the outside event's labels (contract §8.4), checked against the label definitions in force (the packs' declarations and the label files attached on this machine, not this machine's alone); {} otherwise.

remote.description: Claude Code only: the session's Remote Control id, never redacted, as today; null when none. Today's spool field: rc_session.

bonsai_path.description: The bonsai binary's own path, forward slashes, on a session_start record (written at every start), on the guard record that made its log file (and only on that one of the guard's records), and on a ladder record, where it is the runner's own, so the record names which bonsai made the result; null elsewhere. Under the person's home folder it is written from a tilde and a slash, so no user name is in the log (contract §2.6), by the recorder and by the guard alike; elsewhere as it is. Added in set 6, an addition (spec §16 row 27; the name is the one the guard has written since part 5).

bonsai_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the bonsai binary at bonsai_path, 64 lower-case hex characters, on a session_start record (hashed at every start, so a binary swapped between a session and its resume is seen), on the guard record that made its log file and on a ladder record (the runner's own); null elsewhere. Added in set 6, an addition (spec §16 row 27).

parent.description: Claude Code only: on a spawn record, the agent that started this one: its subagent id, or session for the person's own session (and for an agent a Workflow script started, whose Workflow call only that session makes); null on every other record. With subagent_id and tool_use_id it rebuilds the tree of agents after their state files are cleaned (set 8).

usage.description: Claude Code only: on a usage record, one model's token counts as Claude Code saved them in an agent's transcript at its end (a subagent's SubagentStop, a session's SessionEnd), each summed over the whole transcript as recorded: input, output, cache_read and cache_write, the model in model (set 8: raw counts, as decided on 14 Oct). Each record holds the whole transcript's totals at that end, never a difference from an earlier record, so a resumed agent's newest records are its whole; no cost and no estimate. Only the counts and the model are read, never any text. null on every other record, and on a usage record whose transcript could not be read (kind unknown, its reason in reason).

input.description: The input tokens Claude Code saved with each reply of the record's model, summed over the whole transcript.

output.description: The output tokens Claude Code saved with each reply of the record's model, summed over the whole transcript.

cache_read.description: The tokens read from the cache Claude Code saved with each reply of the record's model, summed over the whole transcript.

cache_write.description: The tokens written to the cache Claude Code saved with each reply of the record's model, summed over the whole transcript.
